topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the introductory framing and sets the scope for the lecture.

topics.label: Pathogen and Damage Recognition by Pattern Recognition Receptors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the molecular mechanisms by which the innate immune system senses microbial products and tissue damage through pattern recognition receptors and inflammasome activation.

topics.label: Inflammatory Cell Mobilization, Trafficking, and Systemic Consequences
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how activated sentinel cells direct immune cell trafficking into tissues and lymph nodes, as well as the physiological hazards of uncontrolled systemic activation.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the mechanisms that shut down acute inflammation, restore tissue integrity, and manage persistent challenges through chronic inflammation and granuloma formation.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the closing framing and indicates the topic of the next lecture.
